# 录制与 MP4 输出需求质量 Checklist: 屏幕录制器 (Screen Recorder)

**Purpose**: 验证三种录制模式、开始/停止、MP4 封装、失败与恢复路径等核心录制需求是否完整、清晰、可测
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are start/stop/abort requirements defined for all three capture modes (fullscreen, region, window)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–§FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the output file naming rule (format, uniqueness, collision handling) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the recording frame rate requirement stated in the specification rather than only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are MP4 codec/container constraints (H.264, no audio track) specified or explicitly delegated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the validation method for "可被常见播放器播放" defined (which players, manual vs automated)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the maximum recording duration (or the absence of a limit) specified? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are finalization/repair requirements defined when the app crashes mid-recording? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases, Constitution §技术约束与质量要求]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the disk-space pre-check or in-recording handling specified? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the auto-stop behavior defined when the target window is closed during window-mode recording? [Completeness, Spec US4 scenario 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 - Is "停止后生成 MP4" quantified (time window, size check, visibility in the output folder)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the region-mode output resolution defined precisely (physical pixels versus DIP)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "全屏" defined for multi-monitor and DPI-scaled displays consistently across the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "窗口边界一致" defined for window resizes during recording (scale, crop, or stop)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the failure classes (media error, storage error, encoder error) enumerated with distinct user-facing messages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Do the region requirements align across §FR-006 (drag), §FR-007 (numeric settings), and §SC-004 (output size)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK016 - Does the "no audio" requirement (§FR-014) agree with the MP4 output requirement (§FR-010)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do the edge cases for minimized/closed windows agree with US4 acceptance scenario 3? [Consistency, Spec US4, Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 - Is SC-002 (100% playable MP4) measurable with a defined test protocol? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is SC-003 (three modes × Win10/Win11) attainable as written, with the six runs enumerated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is SC-007 (stop → playable in ≤5s) defined for a stated recording length and hardware baseline? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for rendering performance and correctness when displays are DPI-scaled (125%/150%)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for extremely small or large regions and windows (minimum sizes, 4K displays)? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are concurrent start attempts or repeated "开始" clicks addressed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for window-mode capture when the window is minimized or occluded during recording? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the behavior defined when the recording renderer crashes (no auto-stop possible)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional

- [ ] CHK026 - Is a video bitrate/quality target quantified or explicitly delegated? [Gap, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the acceptable impact on the target application quantified with measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 - Is the assumption that an H.264 encoder is available (hardware or software) documented with fallback expectations? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are file-system requirements (local fixed drives, long paths, removable media) documented? [Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
